source.title: Max Park wins World Rubik's Cube Championship 2017, in Paris, France
source.content:
[Max Park](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2012PARK03) won the [World Rubik's Cube Championship 2017](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WC2017) with an average of 6.85 seconds. [Seung Hyuk Nahm (남승혁)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2013NAHM01) finished second (7.02) and [Lucas Etter](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2011ETTE01) finished third (7.24).

World records: Drew Brads Pyraminx 2.04 (average), Feliks Zemdegs 5x5x5 Cube 38.52 (single), 5x5x5 Cube 46.24 (average), 6x6x6 Cube 1:20.03 (single), 6x6x6 Cube 1:27.79 (average), 7x7x7 Cube 2:06.73 (single), 7x7x7 Cube 2:15.07 (average), Max Park 3x3x3 One-Handed 10.31 (average).  
African records: Moez Boussarsar Pyraminx 4.78 (average).  
Asian records: Seung Hyuk Nahm (남승혁) 5x5x5 Cube 46.36 (single), 5x5x5 Cube 51.21 (average), 5x5x5 Cube 45.54 (single), 5x5x5 Cube 49.51 (average), Yulun Wu (吴宇伦) Pyraminx 2.48 (average).  
Oceanian records: Jack Cai 3x3x3 Blindfolded 23.44 (single), Jayden McNeill Pyraminx 2.10 (single), Square-1 10.36 (average), Square-1 7.47 (single), Square-1 10.07 (average), Tom Nelson 5x5x5 Blindfolded 5:43.86 (single).  
European records: Charlie Stark Square-1 9.07 (average), Ciarán Beahan 6x6x6 Cube 1:45.57 (average), Jules Desjardin Pyraminx 2.32 (average), Oscar Roth Andersen Megaminx 45.07 (average), Sebastian Weyer 5x5x5 Cube 50.88 (average).  
North American records: Bill Wang 4x4x4 Cube 20.69 (single), 4x4x4 Blindfolded 2:09.94 (single), Max Park 5x5x5 Cube 45.38 (single), 5x5x5 Cube 48.09 (average), 5x5x5 Cube 42.63 (single).

translation.title: Max Park 在法国巴黎夺得 2017 年魔方世锦赛冠军
translation.content:
[Max Park](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2012PARK03)以 6.85 秒的平均成绩夺得 [2017 年魔方世锦赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WC2017)冠军。[Seung Hyuk Nahm（남승혁）](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2013NAHM01)以 7.02 秒获得亚军，[Lucas Etter](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2011ETTE01)以 7.24 秒获得季军。

**世界纪录：**Drew Brads：金字塔平均 2.04；Feliks Zemdegs：五阶单次 38.52、平均 46.24，六阶单次 1:20.03、平均 1:27.79，七阶单次 2:06.73、平均 2:15.07；Max Park：三阶单手平均 10.31。

**非洲纪录：**Moez Boussarsar：金字塔平均 4.78。

**亚洲纪录：**Seung Hyuk Nahm（남승혁）：五阶单次 46.36、平均 51.21、单次 45.54、平均 49.51；吴宇伦（Yulun Wu）：金字塔平均 2.48。

**大洋洲纪录：**Jack Cai：三盲单次 23.44；Jayden McNeill：金字塔单次 2.10，Square-1 平均 10.36、单次 7.47、平均 10.07；Tom Nelson：五盲单次 5:43.86。

**欧洲纪录：**Charlie Stark：Square-1 平均 9.07；Ciarán Beahan：六阶平均 1:45.57；Jules Desjardin：金字塔平均 2.32；Oscar Roth Andersen：五魔平均 45.07；Sebastian Weyer：五阶平均 50.88。

**北美洲纪录：**Bill Wang：四阶单次 20.69、四盲单次 2:09.94；Max Park：五阶单次 45.38、平均 48.09、单次 42.63。
